company.name: Halcyon & Reed Bio
company.mission: Silence the genes behind rare liver-driven diseases.

program.nameText: Small interfering RNA medicines end in -siran.
program.targetShort: the faulty protein made in the liver
program.target: a protein made in the liver that misfolds and builds up in nerves and the heart
program.evidence: people who carry gene variants that lower the protein are protected, and lowering it in models slows damage
program.bet: silencing the gene in the liver could stop the protein from building up
program.p1Note: One dose lowered the protein for months, which could allow dosing a few times a year.

modality.label: siRNA
modality.appWhy: siRNA medicines are made by chemical synthesis, so they are approved through a New Drug Application (NDA). Biologics use a BLA.

disease.label: Rare amyloid disease
disease.p2Text: The main measure is how much the faulty protein drops in the blood.
disease.p3Text: One pivotal randomized trial measures nerve function over 18 months.
disease.priceText: several hundred thousand dollars a year before discounts

b: The same protein can build up in the heart.
Trials measure hospital visits and survival.
An siRNA is a short double strand of RNA. Inside a cell it guides an enzyme complex to destroy the matching messenger RNA, so less protein gets made.
Scientists design hundreds of sequences that match {target} and test which ones silence it best.
screen.m: Match the message, stop the protein.

screen.d: Write hundreds of candidate sequences that match the gene.

a: Lead B, almost as strong and far cleaner
q.e: Silencing other genes by accident can cause side effects. Lead B is nearly as strong and much more specific.

list: Pivotal trial met its main goal

welcome.text: Halcyon & Reed spun out of a university lab with < 10 people.
